chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from his forefathers, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:
I heard the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم saying: “Follow the جنازة, and do not let it follow you. Oppose the People of the Book.”

key_terms.أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ: The People of the Book; Jews and Christians in this context.
key_terms.اتْبَعُوا: Follow; a command to accompany in the prescribed manner.
key_terms.الْجَنَازَةَ: The funeral bier or funeral procession being escorted for burial.
key_terms.تَتْبَعُكُمْ: To follow you; here, the funeral should not be behind those accompanying it.
key_terms.خَالِفُوا: Act contrary to; distinguish yourselves in practice.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about how to accompany a funeral procession?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers regarding funeral conduct, commanding them to walk behind or with the جنازة rather than having it proceed behind them. It also frames this practice as a distinct sunnah (prophetic tradition) that differs from the custom of the People of the Book.
